tasks.title: notes/transfer.py: import_json with skip, overwrite and duplicate conflict handling

argv:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import tempfile,os
from notes.storage import NoteStore
s=NoteStore(os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'n.json'),clock=lambda:'T0')
import json
from notes.transfer import import_json
p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'i.json'); json.dump({'version':1,'notes':[{'id':7,'title':'Seven','created':'c7','updated':'u7'}]},open(p,'w'))
print(import_json(s,p), s.get(7).created, s.add('n').id)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import tempfile,os
from notes.storage import NoteStore
s=NoteStore(os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'n.json'),clock=lambda:'T0')
import json
from notes.transfer import import_json
s.add('Old')
p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'i.json'); json.dump({'version':1,'notes':[{'id':1,'title':'New'}]},open(p,'w'))
print(import_json(s,p), import_json(s,p,'overwrite'), s.get(1).title, import_json(s,p,'duplicate'), len(s))
